scope: The 300 g cooked rice and two fried eggs are supported by Shu Han Lee. The sweet soy seasoning uses regular soy sauce, brown sugar and water. All sauce and listed oil are counted. The 20 minutes start with cooked rice. The historic GL refers to a separate study serving. No physical trial was performed.
